description: This file exports constants, functions, and type definitions related to browser configuration settings, including parsing, resolution, and authentication details. It acts as a central module for managing browser configuration data used in the project.

methods.name: parseBrowserHttpUrl
methods.description: Parses a browser HTTP URL into its components.

methods.name: redactCdpUrl
methods.description: Redacts sensitive information from the Chrome DevTools Protocol URL.

methods.name: resolveBrowserConfig
methods.description: Resolves and merges browser configuration settings.

methods.name: resolveBrowserControlAuth
methods.description: Resolves authentication options for browser control.

methods.name: resolveProfile
methods.description: Resolves a browser profile based on provided parameters.
